end.parentNote: Asha practised the categories through examples and comparisons, including boiling points and gravity. Tara used the method of asking whether a statement describes what happens or explains why. They briefly mixed up which idea is tested many times, then corrected the sequence later in the lesson. At home, ask Tara to sort four new statements into observation, hypothesis, law or theory and explain each choice in one sentence.
